name: 8D Corrective Action
description: 8D corrective-action child process spawned by Supplier Quality Deviation for CRITICAL severity; Procurement completes it. Escalation follows D-ESC: timer -> higher role -> fail closed (v1.1, ISS-1002 / Q-984; BA ruling GH #2281). Documented deviation: corrective-action-8d carries an E6 waiver (long-running remediation work) instead of a timer pair, because an escalation timer cancels the task and would end the child, and with it the parent deviation, without any corrective action; the BA-proposed P14D reminder cannot be modelled without an engine feature that notifies while keeping the task open.

attributes.description: Waiver: long-running remediation work (engine gap: a HUMAN_TASK escalation timer always cancels; no non-cancelling reminder — Q-1017 / GH #2325 / ISS-1035). BA ruling GH #2281, E6. The 8D corrective action is open-ended work; an escalation timer would cancel the task and close the deviation with no corrective action, so it stays open until the procurement manager completes it.
